ipa.financial_contracts.cap_floor.InputFlow

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.cap_floor.InputFlow.

Syntax

InputFlow(
    *,
    amount: float | None = None,
    premium_settlement_type: PremiumSettlementType | None = None,
    currency: str | None = None,
    date: str | date | datetime | timedelta | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
amount float | None No None
premium_settlement_type PremiumSettlementType | None No None The cash settlement type of the option premium -spot -forward
currency str | None No None
